svg.title: Glider: first and second orange layers, with no bridging
svg.text: Assembly rule: finish the whole previous layer; every input must connect. No bridging.
Same padded glider and same scale. Second-pass pieces are the same orange type, rotated 90°.
Square/diamond: proposed C profiles. X: blue separator blocker.
Each four-slot row packs three bits and preserves its middle value.
Only the three data columns receive second-pass orange pieces.
Highlighted target cell after the second pass
Upper 3 × 3: five ones, the total of this original neighbourhood.
Bottom three C ports: auxiliary values created by the second pass.
White right column: first-pass C ports, exposed ONE LAYER LOWER.
Its middle two C0 ports preserve the original centre (dead).
The connection from these lower C ports to the final layer still needs a 3D design.
Both orange passes are complete. Purple classification and the black/white output layer come next.
